```{r setup}
res   <- readRDS(file.path("..", "results", "pipeline_results.rds"))
vt    <- res$vt
fits  <- res$lassen$fits
er    <- res$ec50$result
flags <- res$qc_flags
fig   <- function(name) file.path("..", "results", "figures", name)
```
## Aim

To estimate the plasma EC50 of a drug from a PET receptor-occupancy study:
receptor occupancy is derived per scan with the Lassen plot, and related to
the plasma drug concentration with an Emax model. The emphasis of the project
is a reproducible, quality-controlled analysis pipeline.

## Data

All data are simulated; no real subject data are used.

- `r length(unique(vt$subject))` subjects, each scanned three times: baseline,
  block 1 (~3 h after a single oral dose) and block 2 (~24 h after the dose).
  Doses ranged from `r min(res$exposure$dose_mg)` to `r max(res$exposure$dose_mg)` mg.
- `r length(unique(vt$region))` brain regions per scan, with VT estimated by a
  two-tissue compartment model (2TCM) with arterial input
  (`data/raw/vt_estimates.csv`, `r nrow(vt)` estimates).
- Plasma drug concentration measured at the start and end of each block scan
  (`data/raw/drug_plasma.csv`).
## Methods

The pipeline (`scripts/00_run_pipeline.R`) runs all steps from the raw data to
this report. Quality control (QC) is applied after each analysis step; QC
never deletes data but flags it as *exclude* (not used further) or *warning*
(kept, reported). All flags are listed in the separate QC report.

| Step | Method | QC (exclude) |
|---|---|---|
| VT estimates | 2TCM fits as provided | not converged; VT ≤ 0; SE > 25 %; k4 at its lower fit bound |
| Drug exposure | mean of start and end sample per scan | concentration missing or ≤ 0 |
| Occupancy | Lassen plot per subject × block session: VT~base~ − VT~block~ vs VT~base~; slope = occupancy, x-intercept = V~ND~ | fewer than 4 regions; occupancy outside −0.2 to 1.2 |
| EC50 | Emax model, occupancy = C / (C + EC50), least squares on log EC50 | (warnings only: outliers, leave-one-out influence, CI width) |
## Results

### Quality control

Of `r nrow(vt)` VT estimates, `r sum(vt$qc_exclude)` were excluded
(`r sum(grepl("high_se", vt$qc_reason))` for high SE,
`r sum(grepl("k4_at_lower_bound", vt$qc_reason))` for k4 at its lower bound).
All `r nrow(fits)` Lassen fits were usable
(`r sum(fits$qc_exclude)` excluded), giving `r er$n_scans` points for the EC50 fit.
The EC50 QC raised `r sum(flags$stage == "qc_ec50")` flags.
### Receptor occupancy

![Example Lassen plots at low, medium and high occupancy (chosen among fits with R² ≥ 0.8; all fits are shown in the QC report).](`r fig("lassen_examples.png")`)

```{r occupancy-table}
occ <- read.csv(file.path("..", "results", "tables", "occupancy_per_scan.csv"))
occ <- occ[!occ$qc_exclude, ]
knitr::kable(data.frame(Subject = occ$subject, Session = occ$session,
                        `Dose (mg)` = occ$dose_mg,
                        `Plasma conc. (ng/mL)` = signif(occ$conc_ng_mL, 3),
                        Regions = occ$n_regions,
                        Occupancy = sprintf("%.2f ± %.2f", occ$occupancy, occ$occupancy_se),
                        VND = round(occ$VND, 2),
                        check.names = FALSE),
             caption = "Occupancy (± SE) per scan from the Lassen plot.")
```
### Plasma EC50

The plasma EC50 was **`r sprintf("%.1f", er$EC50_ng_mL)` ng/mL**
(95 % CI `r sprintf("%.1f–%.1f", er$ci_low, er$ci_high)`), based on
`r er$n_scans` scans with occ~max~ fixed at `r er$occ_max`.

![Receptor occupancy versus plasma drug concentration with the Emax fit and its 95 % confidence band.](`r fig("ec50_curve.png")`)
## Discussion

- Occupancy is estimated precisely at high occupancy, but the Lassen plot is
  unstable at low occupancy, where VT~base~ − VT~block~ is mostly noise.
- 2TCM fits with k4 at its lower bound gave strongly biased VT with
  normal-looking SEs; excluding them by rule improved the Lassen fits more than
  removing Lassen outliers afterwards.
- Limitations: simulated data; ordinary least squares in the Lassen plot
  ignores noise in VT~base~; occ~max~ fixed at 1.

## Reproducibility

The full analysis is reproduced with `renv::restore()` followed by
`Rscript scripts/00_run_pipeline.R` (see the README).
